setup.find_help: Not in the list? Choose "Not listed" and enter the VPN address from your university's IT help pages.
setup.choose: Choose your university, or Not listed
setup.saml: Your university signs in through a web page. Uni VPN can't do that yet.
setup.sign_in_sub: Your university account, the same as for email.
setup.enter_user: Enter your username, for example ab123
setup.generic_step.1: Open your university's {portal} and add an authenticator app.
setup.generic_step.2: Take a screenshot of the QR code ({shot}) and drop or paste it here.{secret}
setup.generic_step.3: Type this code into the page to finish.{code}
setup.drop_help: Or click the page's otpauth:// link: Uni VPN opens and takes the key. You can also paste the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=.
setup.portal_away: This page only opens on the university network or with the university's VPN.
setup.waiting: Testing the connection. This can take a minute.
setup.auto_sub: Type the code your authenticator app shows now.
setup.auto_help: Uni VPN signs in once with this code and adds itself to your account as a code generator, like a second phone. After that it never asks for codes again. Your app keeps working.
setup.by_hand: Set it up by hand instead
setup.auto_working: Setting up. This can take a minute.
enroll.next_code: Almost done. Wait for the next code in your app and type it here.
enroll.code_wrong: That code didn't work. Wait for the next one and try again.
enroll.refused: Your university didn't allow this. Set it up by hand instead.
enroll.failed: That didn't work. Try again with a new code, or set it up by hand.
enroll.clock: Check that this computer's clock is right, then try again with a new code.
enroll.enter_code: Type the 6-digit code from your app.
enroll.not_here: This doesn't work for your university. Set it up by hand instead.
setup.all_set_sub: University websites now open through the VPN by themselves. Close and reopen your browser once.
setup.all_set_no_domains: Add the websites that should go through the university under Settings, Websites.
main.hint.idle: Connects by itself when you open a university website.
main.hint.connected: University websites go through the VPN.
settings.title: Settings
settings.domains_help: One website per line, for example uni-heidelberg.de. Its pages are included. All other websites stay as they are.
sync.show_offer: Scan or enter this code on the new device
sync.show_request: Scan or enter this code on your other device
sync.code_unknown: This code doesn't work. Check it, or show a new one.
sync.setup_first: Set up Uni VPN on one of the devices first.
sync.offline: Can't reach the sync service. Check the internet connection.
sync.not_used: Some settings from your other devices could not be used here.
totp.line_break: The key must be on one line
totp.only_totp: This key is not for codes that change over time. Choose the time-based one
totp.algorithm: This kind of key isn't supported
totp.not_secret: That's not the setup key. Copy the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=
totp.incomplete: The key is incomplete. Copy the whole line
totp.base32: That's not a valid setup key
totp.no_qr: No QR code found in this picture
totp.not_picture: This picture can't be read. Use a screenshot
totp.qr_not_key: This QR code isn't for sign-in codes
password.line_break: The password must be on one line
address.invalid: Enter the VPN address, for example vpn.example.edu
address.path: After the / the address may only contain letters, numbers and . _ ~ + -
detect.not_cisco: This is not a Cisco VPN address
detect.not_cisco_http: This is not a Cisco VPN address
detect.no_form: This address doesn't ask for a sign-in
msg.waiting_for_code: Waiting a few seconds for a new one-time code
msg.blocked: Paused while Cisco Secure Client is connected
msg.offline: No internet. On public Wi-Fi, sign in to the Wi-Fi first.
msg.password_rejected: Your university did not accept the password.
msg.totp_rejected: The one-time code was not accepted. Check that the computer's clock is right, or enter the setup key again.
msg.append_rejected: Your university did not accept the password or the one-time code. Check the password and the computer's clock.
msg.duo_rejected: Sign-in failed. Check the password, and confirm the Duo request on your phone in time.
msg.auth_rejected: Sign-in failed. Check the password. If it is right, your university asks for something Uni VPN cannot answer yet.
msg.totp_unusable: The saved setup key does not work. Enter it again.
msg.saml_required: Your university signs in through a web page. Uni VPN cannot do that yet.
msg.hostscan_required: Your university checks the computer before it connects. Uni VPN cannot do that yet.
msg.keyring_locked: Your saved passwords are locked. Sign out of the computer and back in, then click Try again.
msg.password_unreadable: The saved password could not be read. Enter it again.
msg.totp_unreadable: The saved setup key could not be read. Enter it again.
msg.password_unsupported: This password contains a character Uni VPN cannot send on this computer. Change the password at your university, then enter it here.
msg.too_slow: Your university did not answer in time. Uni VPN tries again.
msg.connect_failed: Could not connect to your university. Uni VPN tries again.
msg.connection_lost: The connection to your university was lost.
msg.server_untrusted: Your university's server failed a security check. Uni VPN tries again.
msg.port_in_use: Another program is in the way. Uni VPN keeps trying. If this stays, restart the computer.
msg.program_missing: Part of Uni VPN is missing. Click Repair.
msg.start_failed: Uni VPN could not start the connection. Click Repair.
msg.not_elevated: Uni VPN is missing a permission it needs. Click Repair.
msg.settings_broken: Your settings could not be read. Set up Uni VPN again.
msg.repairing: Repairing. Allow it if your computer asks.
msg.repair_failed: The repair did not finish. Click Repair to try again, or restart the computer.
msg.not_running: Uni VPN is not running. Restart the computer to start it again.
phone.scan_code_help: On a computer with Uni VPN, open Settings, Add a device, and scan the code it shows.
phone.setup.all_set_sub: University websites now open through the VPN by themselves.
phone.setup.generic_step.1: Open your university's {portal} and add a new code generator for this phone.
phone.setup.generic_step.2: Scan the QR code it shows, or copy the line starting with otpauth://.
phone.msg.totp_rejected: The one-time code was not accepted. Check that the phone's clock is right, or enter the setup key again.
phone.msg.password_unsupported: This password contains a character Uni VPN cannot send. Change the password at your university, then enter it here.
phone.msg.port_in_use: Another app is in the way. Uni VPN keeps trying. If this stays, restart the phone.
phone.msg.program_missing: Part of Uni VPN is missing. Tap Repair.
phone.msg.start_failed: Uni VPN could not start the connection. Tap Repair.
phone.msg.repair_failed: The repair did not finish. Tap Repair to try again, or restart the phone.
phone.msg.not_running: Uni VPN is not running. Close the app and open it again.
phone.msg.hostscan_required: Your university checks the device before it connects. Uni VPN cannot do that yet.
phone.camera_use: Uni VPN uses the camera to scan QR codes.
phone.camera_denied: Uni VPN may not use the camera. Allow it in Settings.
setup.totp_help: No line starting with otpauth://? Copy the letters after "secret=" instead. Codes on your phone keep working.
phone.uni.heidelberg.mfa.3: Type a name, for example Phone, and tap "Weiter".
phone.uni.heidelberg.mfa.4: Tap "Tokendetails einblenden", copy the line starting with otpauth:// and paste it below.
phone.uni.heidelberg.mfa.5: Tap "Weiter", then "Testen". Type the code shown here and tap "Absenden".
